Context: 6. Extraordinary Leave

- Limit.1. No leave of any kind can be granted to a Government servant for a continuous period exceeding five years. Subject to this limitation, any amount of EOL may be sanctioned to a permanent Government servant.  
- Rule 12.  
- For temporary officials, the limit on any one occasion is(a) All Officials.Up to 3 months with or without medical certificate. - Rule 32 (2) (a).
- 2.
- (b) Officials with a minimum of one year continuous service.Up to 6 months with medical certificate for common ailments.
